topic.title: Workspace Publication Map View
topic.shortdesc: Use the Publication Map view to work with publication contexts, open map content, and manage publications and deliverables in your workspace.

body.p: A Content Fusion publication defines a DITA map that is used to resolve keys in topics and, optionally, a DITAVAL filter that is used to flag or filter profiled content.

The Publication Map view (in the project's Personal Workspace) displays the map of the context publication in a tree editor, making it easier to navigate through topics. Before a publication appears, you must first define it in the Publications Management dialog box. If you modified the publications using the project Publications Management page, you also need to pull incoming changes into your workspace to retrieve the latest publications.

To select a defined publication, use the Context publication drop-down control in the workspace header above the view. This publication is used as the context for the open editors. Changing the publication reloads the currently open editor to match the new context.
When you hover over that control, it displays the input DITA map and DITAVAL filter for the context publication, along with a Configure publication button and a View deliverables button.
All other actions are available from the Actions menu, which you open with the vertical ellipsis button () in the top-right corner of the view header.

To add a new publication, select New publication from the Actions menu. This opens a submenu with options for creating a new publication:
From existing DITA map - Adds a new publication based on an existing DITA map. In the resulting dialog box, enter a name for the publication and specify the context DITA map and, optionally, a DITAVAL filter file.
From new DITA map - Adds a new publication based on a new DITA map. In the resulting dialog box, enter a Title for the new publication, specify the path of the Parent folder, and choose the Map type (either Map or Bookmap).
When you finish configuring the options, click the Create button at the bottom of the dialog box to add the publication.

Select Manage publications from the Actions menu to open the Manage publications dialog box, where you can access all publication management features, including creating, editing, and deleting publications. You can also open this dialog box by selecting Manage publications from the publications drop-down list.
To refresh the list of publications, select Refresh from the Actions menu.

You can click the View deliverables button (in the details of the context publication, in the workspace header) to open the deliverables management page for the particular publication where you can create new deliverables, build an existing deliverable, view logs, download deliverables, and schedule periodic builds for a deliverable to automate the process.
You can use the Type to filter text field to search for a file by name.
Click a file displayed in the side pane to open it in the visual editor (or double-click a file when the map is open in the tree editor).

p.note: For the map to be editable, the Enable tree editing in the Publications side-view option in the Profile Settings page must be selected (default value). If that option is deselected, the map is displayed as read only.

u.b: Add Documents to New Review Task

body.p: You can add topics to a new review task from this page by right-clicking the particular topics and selecting Add to review task from the contextual menu. This creates a new review task, adds the selected file(s), and opens the New Review Task page where you can configure the new task.

section.title: Manage Publications Dialog Box
section.p: The Manage publications dialog box lets you create and configure publications. You can use these publications as context in new review tasks, in deliverables, and in your personal workspace.

To add a new publication from the management dialog box, click the New publication button in the top-right corner. This opens a drop-down menu with options for creating a new publication:
From existing DITA map - Adds a new publication based on an existing DITA map. In the resulting dialog box, enter a name for the publication and specify the context DITA map and, optionally, a DITAVAL filter file.
From new DITA map - Adds a new publication based on a new DITA map. In the resulting dialog box, enter a Title for the new publication, specify the path of the Parent folder, and choose the Map type (either Map or Bookmap).
When you finish configuring the options, click the Create button at the bottom of the dialog box to add the publication.

Each publication in the list has a View deliverables button that opens the deliverables management page for that publication. To edit an existing publication, click the Configure button next to it. To delete an existing publication, click the Delete button next to it.

If you have an existing DITA-OT project file, you can include all the <context> elements as Publications in your project using the Include publications... button (available when managing publications from the workspace). This action adds an <include> element to the 's built-in DITA-OT project file.There are some limitations regarding the supported DITA-OT project files:
A <context> element that contains more than one <profile> element is not supported and will be ignored.
Deliverables are not loaded from your project file, but this may be supported in the future.
